structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

If the 1500 kg FASSI F 28 B22 hydraulic truck-mounted crane at position 3 had been used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often did it have to be verified in 2024?

response.text: In 2024, what was the required verification frequency for the 1500 kg FASSI F 28 B22 hydraulic truck-mounted crane at position 3, assuming it was operated under normal conditions, meaning outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors?
